run_A2C_training: run the A2C reinforcement learning algorithm with config, environment, and agent factory functions
create_A2C_instance: create an A2C instance with config, create_env, create_train_env, and create_agent callbacks
compute_A2C_loss: compute the A2C loss including critic loss, policy loss, and entropy loss from trajectories
review_A2C_get_loss: review the A2C get_loss method that computes temporal difference and entropy for trajectory updates
refactor_A2C_run: refactor the A2C run method to support custom optimizer or logging configuration
